title: What Happened at the State Dinner Between Trump and Xi
seoTitle: Inside the Trump-Xi State Dinner at the White House
subtitle: Details of the ceremony that marked Xi Jinping's visit to the US capital
excerpt: Presidents Donald Trump and Xi Jinping attended a White House state dinner, exchanging praise and touching on AI and Taiwan, without advancing on.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The meeting between US President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping culminated in a high-profile state dinner at the White House. The event was marked by speeches of mutual praise and mentions of areas for cooperation, such as artificial intelligence, without the signing of new trade agreements.

The symbolism of the state dinner

During the dinner, Xi emphasized the importance of cooperation between the two nations, describing the friendship between the peoples as "a worthy cause that holds great promise." The American president responded by highlighting the history of trade and friendship among Brazil, the United States, and China, stating that "we have never been better."

Topics addressed in the discussion

Among the topics discussed, the leaders touched on the need to manage the development of artificial intelligence responsibly, suggesting peaceful coexistence in the technological arena. Tensions surrounding Taiwan were also mentioned, with Xi urging the US to take a stand against the island's independence.

Absence of business representatives

Unlike previous visits, Xi did not bring a delegation of Chinese business executives. This absence was interpreted as an indication that there is still no substantial progress in trade or investment relations between the two countries.

Diplomatic repercussions

The dinner took place amid press restrictions imposed by Trump, which barred several media outlets from attending. Although the measure was overturned in court, it raised concerns among officials on both sides regarding public perception of the meeting.

Outlook for bilateral relations

Despite statements of goodwill, core issues such as US support for Taiwan and American restrictions on Chinese technologies remain unresolved. The dinner therefore represented more of a symbolic gesture than a turning point in relations between the two powers.

With information from CNN.
